eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the headline, in AWS orange (e.g. 'Arquitetura alvo', 'Reference architecture', 'RFP anexo II').

title.description: Headline shown above the description (e.g. 'Portal do Cidadão — target architecture').

text.description: One paragraph saying what this diagram shows and for whom.

meta.description: Small dot-separated facts under the text: version, date, environment, author, ticket.
